title: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
friendlyTitle: One open gateway for several coding agents
summary: Free Claude Code is an open-source gateway for using coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Pi from terminals, IDEs, apps or phones. The Python-led project has attracted more than 43,000 GitHub stars and was updated this week.
friendlySummary: This project connects tools like Claude Code, Codex and Pi so they can be used from different devices and apps.
whyItMatters: It can give developers one interface for experimenting with different coding-agent clients and access routes. Review provider terms, authentication methods and any third-party routing before connecting accounts or sensitive repositories.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is useful for testing several coding agents, but check the security and account rules before using private code.
